ZenGridsArchitecture studio

Narrating architecture, one grid at a time.

ZenGrids is an architecture studio of architects and engineers. We design and build homes, interiors and landscapes that fit the people who live in them.

Start a projectSee our services

A studio built around the client

We work across architecture, interior design and landscape design. Our aim is the highest level of client service: clear, consistent communication, anticipating your needs, and making the process as smooth and efficient as we can.

Your input is welcome at every stage. We respond quickly and decisively, and we adjust our process to suit each client and each project.

Clear communicationYou always know where your project stands.
Quick, decisive responsesQuestions and changes are handled without delay.
Flexible processWe shape our way of working to fit you and your site.

What we do

Seven services, from the first conversation to the finished home.

Architectural Consultation

Early advice on your site, budget, regulations and options before you commit.

Architectural Design

Concept to detailed drawings for homes and buildings that suit how you live.

Home Renovation & Remodeling

Reworked layouts, extensions and upgrades for homes that no longer fit.

Home Restoration

Careful repair of older homes that keeps their character and strengthens their structure.

Interior Design

Layouts, materials, lighting and furniture planned together for each room.

Landscape Design

Gardens, courtyards and outdoor spaces that extend the home.

New Home Construction

Design and build under one roof, with engineers on hand from foundation to finish.
